description: This file contains network I/O utility functions and socket handling routines for a lightweight HTTP server or network application. It includes functions for reading from and writing to sockets, handling errors, and managing socket options like TCP_CORK. It also defines functions for reading and writing data with retries after interruptions, and some network status management.

methods.name: GQuark li_network_error_quark(void)
methods.description: Returns a GQuark representing 'g-network-error-quark', used for error domain identification.

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_write(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Writes data to a socket, retrying if interrupted by signals (EINTR).

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_read(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Reads data from a socket, retrying if interrupted by signals (EINTR).

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_write(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset write_max,GError ** err)
methods.description: Writes data from a chunk queue to a socket, optionally using TCP_CORK to optimize TCP packet sending. Chooses between sendfile or writev based on configuration.

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_read(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset read_max,liBuffer ** buffer,GError ** err)
methods.description: Reads data from a socket into a buffer, with flow control based on limits, handling partial reads, socket errors, and connection closure.
